prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: explanatory scenario illustration for n³ Hearingpedia Chinese hearing-science encyclopedia, adult readers. Landscape 3:2 canvas.
Primary request: show WHY a personal remote microphone changes the pickup location in a university classroom. One coherent classroom scene, with a teacher at the front LEFT and an adult university student seated at a desk some distance away in the RIGHT foreground, facing the teacher. Two understated other students and a few desks establish the classroom distance, without crowding the main devices.
Style/medium: polished mature editorial cartoon, anatomically plausible adult people, clean soft outlines and restrained shading. Warm white and pale lavender, blue-grey and muted teal. Match a calm Chinese educational encyclopedia, not a children’s comic or product advertisement.
Composition: spacious, readable. Teacher is talking normally with a SMALL wireless remote microphone TRANSMITTER visibly CLIPPED to their shirt collar/upper chest near the mouth, not held in hand. Student has a recognizable small BEHIND-THE-EAR HEARING AID: curved device body behind the visible ear, thin earhook/tube leading into an earmold at the ear canal; not an earbud, headset or cochlear-implant disc. The teacher and student look calm and engaged; no exaggerated suffering or miracle cure.
Make the actual two device locations obvious using TWO magnifying circular inset illustrations connected by fine neutral leader lines to their corresponding locations in the main scene. LEFT inset: close view of the same clip-on microphone on teacher’s collar with exact caption "近距离拾音". RIGHT inset: side view of the student’s ear with the same behind-the-ear hearing aid, exact caption "传入助听器". Large enough for reading on a web article. Leave faces unobstructed.
A single clearly directional dashed lavender conceptual arrow starts at the teacher's remote microphone and goes across the classroom to the student's hearing aid. Arrowhead at the hearing aid. Exact centered label "无线传输". Distinguish this conceptual signal-link arrow from the neutral inset leader lines. NO return arrow, NO beam from mouth directly to student, NO loudspeaker or room PA, NO continuous cable between people. The remote mic picks up speech near the teacher and sends the signal wirelessly to a compatible hearing aid. Environmental sound still exists; don't imply the system eliminates all noise or makes hearing normal.
Exact title along the top: "远程传声：把拾音位置移近说话人".
Only these Chinese labels plus watermark, no other text, no chalkboard formulas, no quantitative benefits or device specifications, no brand logos.
Mandatory watermark in LOWER-RIGHT corner of overall canvas, exact two right-aligned lines: "n³ Hearingpedia" and "OpenAI ImageGen". Small readable muted-purple sans-serif, first line a little larger, correct superscript 3, subtle translucent warm-white backing patch inset from the edge, not overlapping scientific labels or the student’s hearing aid.
Accuracy priority: source is near-mouth collar mic on teacher, destination is student's EAR-SIDE hearing aid, dashed arrow travels teacher-to-student, both corresponding close-ups show realistic generic devices in the SAME positions as the classroom scene. No visible acoustical rays, no anatomy cross-sections, no extra process boxes.
